scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sapsii/db && npm run build --workspace @sapsii/api && npm run build --workspace @sapsii/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sapsii/db && npm run typecheck --workspace @sapsii/api
scripts.demo: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names oidc,api,sim,ui "npm run demo:oidc --workspace @sapsii/api" "npm run dev:api" "npm run db:simulate-demo -- --organization sapsii-dev" "npm run dev:ui"
